name: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty

locations.note: 2007: Snake drops from the George Washington Bridge onto a tanker sailing down the Hudson with the new Metal Gear RAY aboard.
The tanker chapter on the Hudson, and two years later the Big Shell in the harbour, put the whole story in and around New York.
2009: rookie Raiden infiltrates the Big Shell, the clean-up facility built over the tanker's sinking, where the Sons of Liberty hold the President.
Arsenal Gear crashes into Manhattan and comes to rest at Federal Hall, where Raiden fights Solidus on the roof.

routes.name: Snake and Raiden
routes.note: The tanker in 2007, the Big Shell in 2009, the finale in Manhattan.
